delivery.reason: Local owner configuration chooses a delivery surface; this public adapter does not configure one.

startupHydration.reason: Grok Bot has a separate computer; automatic startup hydration would target the wrong machine. Use boot_jarvos or jarvos_hydrate after connecting to the vault-host URL.

read.reason: No public Grok Bot note-read bridge is declared.

update.reason: No public Grok Bot note-update bridge is declared.

journalLink.reason: No public Grok Bot journal-link bridge is declared.

discover.reason: Skill projection is out of scope for this adapter.

invoke.reason: Skill projection is out of scope for this adapter.

declare.reason: No public Grok Bot authorization contract is shipped.

enforce.reason: Grok Bot owns native tool authorization.

declare.reason: No public Grok Bot egress declaration is shipped.

startupHook.reason: startupHydration is unsupported; there is no Grok Bot startup hook on the vault host.

handoff.reason: No public Grok Bot handoff adapter is declared.

receive.reason: jarvOS does not expose SendMessage or CloudAgent from this adapter.

validate.reason: jarvOS does not expose SendMessage or CloudAgent from this adapter.

receipt.reason: No public Grok Bot lifecycle receipt bridge is declared.

invoke.reason: CloudAgent coding host is out of scope; Grok Bot is not a jarvOS coding entrypoint.

mcp.registration: On the VAULT HOST run modules/jarvos-agent-context/scripts/jarvos-mcp-http.js (authenticated Streamable HTTP in front of jarvos-mcp.js; Mcp-Session-Id per initialize). On Grok Bot register only the tunneled URL plus bearer token. Do not register stdio MCP on the Grok Bot disk; that hydrates the wrong machine. The token grants the full MCP surface, not only requiredTools.

hydration.command: After the remote connector is reachable, use the boot_jarvos prompt or call the jarvos_hydrate MCP tool.
hydration.reason: startupHydration is unsupported because Grok Bot is a separate computer from the canonical vault.

unsupportedCapabilities.reason: Automatic session-start hydration is unsupported; stdio on Grok Bot would bind the wrong machine.
